faq.heading: Questions
faq.q1: How accurate is the calorie estimate?
faq.a1: Deglem's AI is trained on a large food dataset and gives you a close estimate from a single photo. You can fine-tune any result in a tap.
faq.a2: Your meal photos are processed to estimate nutrition and are not shared. See our Privacy Policy for the details.
faq.a3: Yes — Deglem is free to download on iOS and Android.
faq.a4: Analysis needs a connection to run, but your logged meals stay available to review anytime.
